The petitioner- Institute seeks that it be declared that it is entitled to start the Pharmacy Courses namely "Diploma in Pharmacy" and "Bachelor of Pharmacy" on the basis of approval having been obtained from the Pharmacy Council of India and without obtaining approval from the respondent in terms of circular dated 07.06.2019 with the alternative prayer that the respondent be directed to the grant of approval to the petitioner for "Diploma in Pharmacy" and "Bachelor of Pharmacy"
